The city rests on a central section of the [[Long Beach Barrier Island]], which is the westernmost of the [[Outer Barrier|outer barrier islands]] off the [[South Shore (Long Island)|South Shore]] of Long Island. The city's population was 35,029 at the [[2020 United States census]].{{Cite web |title=U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts: Long Beach city, New York |url=https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/longbeachcitynewyork/PST045219 |access-date=February 9, 2021 |website=www.census.gov |language=en |archive-date=May 3, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210503141652/https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/longbeachcitynewyork/PST045219 |url-status=live }} The '''City of Long Beach''' was incorporated in 1922,{{Cite web |url=http://www.longbeachny.org/index.asp?Type=B_BASIC&SEC=%7B28E55847-1D6D-4DBD-B1E1-40C6A6D151EB%7D&DE=%7B42F2F6EA-F074-43E6-8FB6-BD845285CF9C%7D |title=Our History provided by Newsday (City of Long Beach Official Site) |access-date=August 23, 2009 |archive-date=October 14, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121014224542/http://longbeachny.org/index.asp?Type=B_BASIC&SEC=%7B28E55847-1D6D-4DBD-B1E1-40C6A6D151EB%7D&DE=%7B42F2F6EA-F074-43E6-8FB6-BD845285CF9C%7D |url-status=live }} and is nicknamed "The City by the Sea" (the [[Latin]] form, ''Civitas ad mare'', is the city's motto). Long Beach is bordered by [[East Atlantic Beach, New York|East Atlantic Beach]] to the west, and [[Lido Beach, New York|Lido Beach]] to the east, on the Long Beach Barrier Island—which in turn is surrounded by the [[Reynolds Channel]] to the north, east and west, and the [[Atlantic Ocean]] to the south.{{Cite web |title=- City Manager - the City of Long Beach, New YorkÂ |url=http://www.longbeachny.gov/index.asp?Type=B_DIR&SEC=%7BC50281EA-B062-44FD-B714-35C29EDE6CB7%7D&DE=%7B322DB027-B794-4136-AC30-91FE0BE18855%7D |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170708020500/http://www.longbeachny.gov/index.asp?Type=B_DIR&SEC=%7BC50281EA-B062-44FD-B714-35C29EDE6CB7%7D&DE=%7B322DB027-B794-4136-AC30-91FE0BE18855%7D |archive-date=July 8, 2017 |access-date=August 18, 2019}} In 2022, Long Beach was named one of the best [[East Coast of the United States|East Coast]] towns for a summer getaway by ''[[Time Out (magazine)|Time Out]]'' magazine.{{Cite news |last=Dana |first=Lauren |date=March 31, 2022 |title=The best East Coast beach towns for a summer getaway |work=[[Time Out (magazine)|Time Out]] |url=https://www.timeout.com/usa/travel/best-east-coast-beach-towns |access-date=April 11, 2022 |archive-date=April 11, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220411160648/https://www.timeout.com/usa/travel/best-east-coast-beach-towns |url-status=live }}
